terra.problem: “Even then, the family list keeps going” implies that Aaron’s line continues beyond Jehozadak’s exile. The genealogy ends with Jehozadak; the lists that follow trace other Levite lines.

The passage records cities and pasturelands allotted to Levite clans; it does not say God gave everyone a home. Nor does it establish an unqualified promise that every reader has a place and a specific job in God’s house.
